findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "generate" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: generate · Public sink: generate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: generate · Public sink: generate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
